Stale or refused, the same on both: the forge’s 409 (head moved) becomes 412, and its 405 (can’t merge now) a refusal, so ARTIE handles one set of answers.
say: Every row is from the recorded runs: ARTIE's request to the gateway, and the gateway's call upstream, joined by traceparent. ARTIE sends the same thing to both gateways. Only the connector's YAML knows the forge.
